messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the new Awards and Competition Committee space. Let us begin reviewing the draft judging protocols for our inaugural annual event.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Thanks Jing. I have posted the draft category definitions for washed rind blocks so we can start standardizing our scoring sheets.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: The washed rind scoring sheets look solid. We should make sure the texture criteria account for moisture loss during extended aging.

messages.author: camille.charbonneau.100290@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Agreed with Hector. Entry numbers are rising nicely this year, so clear texture definitions will save the judges a lot of debate.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Good progress team. Thibault, can you ensure the logistics guide for stewards is ready before the spring workshop?

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The steward guide is nearly finished. We are emphasizing temperature control in the holding room this year to keep samples consistent.

messages.author: satoshi.fujimoto.101294@postfield.example
messages.text: Entries from our regional makers have increased significantly. We might need a dedicated intake desk for international shipping boxes.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Given the current public health situation, we are pausing in-person judging and shifting our focus to online educational modules for the autumn.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: The virtual sensory symposium is shaping up well. We will use the digital tasting sheets we developed last winter for the remote sessions.

messages.author: camille.charbonneau.100290@bluebarn.example
messages.text: It is wonderful to plan for an in-person competition again. Table space will be tight with the surge in artisan entries.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: We need to finalize the speaker candidates for the judging seminar before next month. Please send me your recommendations.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Our current competition capacity is fully stretched. We should evaluate whether to cap entries per category for the upcoming year.

messages.author: hector.guerrero.100463@emberleafinecheese.example
messages.text: Capping entries makes sense given the rising operational costs and hardship some smaller creameries are facing right now.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: I have circulated the meeting summary covering our discussion on hardship dues and streamlined entry processes.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: Let us review the completed draft for the guidance revision on raw milk aging rules before the spring meeting.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Workshop venue logistics are fully coordinated. The regional team has done a fantastic job setting up the tasting stations.

messages.author: bianca.fonseca.100019@verhoevendaughtersfine.example
messages.text: I am currently updating the committee charter page to reflect our updated focus on traceability standards.

messages.author: duarte.carvalho.100090@mailhaven.example
messages.text: Speaker invitations for the upcoming competition sessions are out, and we are just waiting on final RSVPs.
